title: Last-Iterate Analyses of FTRL with the 1/2-Tsallis Entropy in Stochastic Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2510.22819v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The convergence analysis of online learning algorithms is central to machine learning theory, where the last-iterate convergence is particularly important, as it captures the learner's actual decisions and describes the evolution of the learning process over time. However, in multi-armed bandits, most existing algorithmic analyses mainly focus on the order of regret, while the last-iterate (simple regret) convergence rate remains less explored---especially for the widely studied Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) algorithms. Recently, FTRL with the $1/2$-Tsallis entropy regularizer $\Psi(p) = -4\sum_{i=1}^d \sqrt{p_i}$ (the $1/2$-Tsallis-INF algorithm, by arXiv:1807.07623) was shown to achieve the desirable Best-of-Both-Worlds (BOBW) guarantees and perform well in both adversarial and stochastic settings. Nevertheless, its last-iterate convergence rate has not yet been fully studied. This paper studies the $1/2$-Tsallis-INF algorit

translated_title: 随机老虎机中带1/2-Tsallis熵的FTRL算法的最后迭代分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.22819v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：在线学习算法的收敛分析是机器学习理论的核心，其中最后迭代收敛尤为重要，因为它捕捉了学习者的实际决策，并描述了学习过程随时间的演变。然而，在多臂老虎机问题中，大多数现有算法分析主要关注遗憾值的阶数，而最后迭代（简单遗憾）的收敛速率仍较少被探索——尤其是对于广泛研究的跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）算法。最近，带有1/2-Tsallis熵正则化器$\Psi(p) = -4\sum_{i=1}^d \sqrt{p_i}$的FTRL算法（1/2-Tsallis-INF算法，见arXiv:1807.07623）被证明能获得理想的“两全其美”（BOBW）保证，并在对抗性和随机环境中均表现良好。然而，其最后迭代收敛速率尚未被充分研究。本文研究了1/2-Tsallis-INF算法。
tldr: 本文首次深入分析了1/2-Tsallis-INF算法在多臂老虎机中的最后迭代收敛速率，填补了该算法在简单遗憾方面研究的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first in-depth analysis of the last-iterate convergence rate of the 1/2-Tsallis-INF algorithm in multi-armed bandits, filling a gap in the study of its simple regret.
